pages.text: Tamed with 13 beef and found in plains biomes, where each wild one lives at a ground nest of one or two eggs that it patrols and fiercely guards: stay away from the nest, and never break an egg. They can be mounted and ridden at high speed, and will also fight alongside you. When tamed they receive a boost in health and speed. They are bred with glyptodon meat! Made to sit or stand by shift clicking. They can be healed with beef.
